1.2.0.en: Updated meshdriver, added new model for YD-01-CON

1.2.1.en: Fix PIN-code updates, protect PIN fields, and add App Store metadata

1.2.2.en: Show PIN codes in device settings.

1.2.3.en: Use the supported Z-Wave Door Lock and Notification capability mappings.

1.2.4.en: Add the Yale Door Lock command-class v1 parser.

1.2.5.en: Diagnostic build for the lock command path.

1.2.6.en: Diagnostic build for Homey device routing.

1.2.7.en: Restore lock control by adding the missing Homey driver class.

1.2.8.en: Store Homey PIN slots 1-10 in Yale PIN slots 41-50 and require 6-12 digit PINs.

1.2.9.en: Add a read-only maintenance action to retrieve Yale PIN slots 41-50.

1.2.10.en: Fix the Z-Wave User Code field name used for PIN reads and writes.

1.2.11.en: Use Yale's Z-Wave User Code IDs 1-10 for PIN read and write operations.

1.2.12.en: Process Yale PIN reads from asynchronous User Code reports.

1.2.13.en: Keep Homey's saved PINs unchanged when Yale returns status-only PIN reports.

1.2.14.en: Simplify the PIN settings page and remove the status-check action.

1.2.15.en: Remove duplicate PIN labels from the settings page.

1.2.16.en: Show all PIN fields in one compact settings group.

1.2.17.en: Restore the original PIN settings layout from the archive.

1.2.18.en: Temporarily add a diagnostic read of Yale User Code reports.

1.2.19.en: Remove the temporary PIN read diagnostic.

1.2.20.en: Send Yale PIN values in the required Z-Wave binary format.

1.2.21.en: Fix the Z-Wave User Code payload field used to write PINs.

1.2.22.en: Fix removal of saved Yale PINs.
